## Change

What question, correction, or task does this address? Link the project or issue if applicable. For a small correction, a sentence is enough.

## Evidence and checks

Identify sources or results supporting the change. State checks actually performed, who or what performed them, and the outcomes. Identify uncertainty and human review still needed. Remove this section if it adds nothing to a trivial correction.

## People and agent assistance

Name the responsible human. For material agent assistance, identify the tool or model when known, its task, and the selected skill/workflow version. Report completed checks and pending human review accurately. Routine spelling assistance needs no separate account.

## Review needed

What should a reviewer examine? Identify any changes to research methods, conclusions, shared rules, workflows, data access, or publication readiness. This submission is a request for review. Do not prefill an approval.
